חמש קבוצות של סליידרים נכנסות לצומת Pyth: Five groups of sliders feed one Python node, and the code builds the real geometry in Revit: the treads, the landing and every rod in the truss.

את הקוד כתבתי יחד עם Claude: אני מתאר את: I wrote the code together with Claude: I describe the stair, the AI writes the Python, Revit builds, and I check by eye and correct. This is computational design - the intent is the parameters, and the model follows from them. The same method works for any element that repeats with variations: railings, facades, furniture, structure.
